title: Barangay chairman, relative escape shooting in Oriental Mindoro
summary: A barangay chairman and his relative escaped unharmed after two suspects allegedly opened fire on them in Barangay San Narciso, Victoria, Oriental Mindoro, on Tuesday morning.
